brand_vibe: Classic barber-pole red, white and black boutique barbershop identity (own logo badge: 'Tightworx Barbershop, Est. 2017, Premium Cuts & Shaves'). Dark charcoal base with a bold red accent (adapted from the design system's dark template) fits the real brand better than the Miami head-spa gold palette.

services.name: Young Man cut (All Even)
services.note: This cut is without a blend.

images_discarded_reasons: Excluded: selfies and close-up portraits (several review photos and IG posters were customer/staff selfies unrelated to haircut results), photos with heavy on-image text/UI (Instagram story headers, 'PLAYS OF THE WEEK' and 'MR HIM' Reels banners were cropped out where the underlying photo was strong enough to save; fully text-covered promo cards were dropped), a masked selfie, an extreme macro forehead shot, and a sideways photo of loose cut dreadlocks (interesting but too personal/off-brand for the gallery).
